header.description: Semantics of the @stylexjs/atoms compile-time package, pinned against @stylexjs/babel-plugin 0.19.0. Covers import/require recognition forms, static property-access atoms, dynamic call atoms, props()/attrs() merging, rule ordering vs create(), hoisting, dev/prod differences, and option interactions. The atoms package itself need not be installed: the babel plugin bundles @stylexjs/atoms/babel-transform and never resolves the specifier on disk.
header.notes: Jobs carrying an explicit options.dev run in that mode regardless of --mode. The remainder are mode-agnostic; run with --mode both to cover the dev/prod split.
header.note: The Flow `import typeof` probe was replaced by its TypeScript `import type` equivalents: the plugin handles both in one branch (index.js:795), and oxc parses TypeScript, not Flow.
